title: Terminal: everything together
question: Where should snippets live? (Try Split, Palette and Focus in each)

variants.label: Snippet chips
variants.notes: Snippets as colored chips under the terminal, always one click away. All three: sessions sidebar (incl. detached sessions), split view, command palette (Ctrl Shift P or button), Focus mode that hides the app chrome.

variants.label: Snippet drawer
variants.notes: Snippets in a right drawer you can hide with the Snippets button. All three: sessions sidebar (incl. detached sessions), split view, command palette (Ctrl Shift P or button), Focus mode that hides the app chrome.

variants.label: Snippets in sidebar
variants.notes: Snippets listed under the sessions in the left sidebar, so the terminal keeps all its width. All three: sessions sidebar (incl. detached sessions), split view, command palette (Ctrl Shift P or button), Focus mode that hides the app chrome.
